author: Tazz
body:
Hello

I was warned for abusing /report. I did not abuse /report - I was simply telling you that one of our players had supposedly been DDoSed and before the match I was told to report this if this had happened. I reported myself because I could not report anybody else. I can't report the player being DDoSed because he's offline, I can't report the DDoSer because I don't know him.

Thanks for your time

Tazz
